requiresConfirmation.title: requiresConfirmation
requiresConfirmation.description: True when the preview is shown and member confirmation is required before executing.

confirmationToken.title: confirmationToken
confirmationToken.description: Single-use token to pass back when the member confirms. Never reveal to the member.

preview.title: preview
preview.description: Human-readable description of the action to be performed, shown to the member before confirmation.

resultRecordId.title: resultRecordId
resultRecordId.description: ID of the committed record on success.

message.title: message
message.description: Status or error message describing the outcome of the preview or execution.
